01 — About

Hi, I'm Raghav.

Results-oriented Power BI Data Analyst with 2.5+ years of experience delivering interactive dashboards, optimizing data workflows, and enabling data-driven business decisions. Expert in data modelling, DAX, Power Query, SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy), and Azure data ecosystems.

Proven track record of converting raw data into actionable insights, implementing ETL workflows (SSIS), and developing KPI-driven dashboards with Azure Monitor and Power BI Service. Experienced across the analytics lifecycle: data integration, cleansing, modelling, visualization, and refresh monitoring.
